#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read retained failure receipts; never import/run the measurement validator."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import datetime

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CTX=ROOT.parent/'round28-G8-original-driver-context/restored'
S=ROOT/'shard-original'
def load(p): return json.loads(p.read_bytes())
def info(p):
    b=p.read_bytes()
    return {'path':str(p),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),
            'git_blob':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()}
def inventory(p):
    return {x.relative_to(p).as_posix():{'bytes':x.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(x.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
            for x in p.rglob('*') if x.is_file()}

before=inventory(S)
record=load(S/'shard.json');native=load(S/'native/report.json');transport=load(ROOT/'original-transport-review.json')
source=load(S/'source-before.json');old=load(CTX/'shard-50000-0/source-before.json')
assert source==load(S/'source-after.json') and (S/'source-before.json').read_bytes()==(S/'source-after.json').read_bytes()
assert source['inputs']==old['inputs'] and len(source['inputs'])==source['input_count']==1095
assert source['source_commit']==record['source_commit']==old['source_commit']=='4fe927488d5cb7f26bd27c7624745fb1b6ca202b'
assert record['source_manifest_sha256']==source['manifest_sha256']==old['manifest_sha256']
assert record['files']=={k:v for k,v in before.items() if k!='shard.json'}
assert len(record['files'])==11
assert record['status']=='failed' and type(record['exit_code']) is int and record['exit_code']==3
assert native['status']=='deadline_exceeded' and native['exit_code']==3
assert native['worker_exit_code'] is None and native['stderr_complete'] is False
assert native['summary'] is None and not (S/'native/worker-summary.json').exists()
assert (S/'supervisor.stdout').read_bytes()==(S/'native/report.json').read_bytes()
assert (S/'supervisor.stderr').read_bytes()==(S/'native/worker.stderr').read_bytes()==b''
assert native['worker_binary_unchanged'] is True
assert native['worker_binary_digest_before']==native['worker_binary_digest_after']==record['binary_blake3']=='9336dfc29e37b13ddbf70c39349d69ec95e77aa8fb20b993b6adb2165c5d84b6'
assert record['binary_sha256']=='39d43ac518d2dc4782e3c75a781c6e8a90982897af4ddd479c00b7505e38cb78'
assert record['build_receipt_sha256']=='f5f9ac1478739ce658c007fa985ef897f60cefebad2ee471af32c7509ff8fa9e'
plan=record['plan']
assert plan==load(S/'registered-plan.json')==load(S/'native/plan.json')
assert (S/'registered-plan.json').read_bytes()==(S/'native/plan.json').read_bytes()
assert plan=={'batch_sizes':[1,10,100,1000],'capacity_profile':'scale_capacity_v1','deadline_ms':18000000,
             'dirty_budget':200,'fanouts':[1,4,16,64,128],'files':[100000],'max_output_bytes':536870912,
             'max_resume_builds':1024,'profile':'release','repetitions':30,'schema_version':1,
             'seed':12648430,'shard':{'count':30,'index':0},'skip_fanout':True}
drivers={}
for name,digest in record['driver_source']['inputs'].items():
    p=CTX/'source-exact-G8-attempt02'/name
    assert info(p)['sha256']==digest
    drivers[name]=info(p)
driver=CTX/'source-exact-G8-attempt02/scripts/p8_scale_matrix.py'
assert info(driver)['sha256']=='f169b0f26cf2a87d3e2548d734431c530cbf63d353ac054045ec8be80889f957'
lines=driver.read_text().splitlines()
predicate='\n'.join(lines[753:759])
assert 'record.get("status") == "passed"' in predicate and 'record.get("exit_code") == 0' in predicate
capacity=load(ROOT/'capacity-original/receipt.json')
assert capacity['source_commit']==record['source_commit'] and capacity['scale']==100000
assert capacity['context']['GITHUB_RUN_ID']=='37962416564' and capacity['context']['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']=='1'
assert capacity['status']=='capacity_available' and capacity['exit_code']==0
assert transport['source']==record['source_commit'] and transport['run']==37962416564 and transport['attempt']==1
assert [x['artifact_id'] for x in transport['artifacts']]==[11647876945,11632534258]
assert all(x['crc_ok'] is True for x in transport['artifacts'])
for art in transport['artifacts']:
    root=Path(art['extracted_path'])
    for member in art['members']:
        m=info(root/member['name']);assert m['bytes']==member['bytes'] and m['sha256']==member['sha256']
log=(ROOT/'job.original-decoded.log').read_text().splitlines()
checkout=[{'line':i+1,'text':v}for i,v in enumerate(log) if v.endswith(' 4fe927488d5cb7f26bd27c7624745fb1b6ca202b')]
exitlines=[{'line':i+1,'text':v}for i,v in enumerate(log) if 'Process completed with exit code 1.' in v]
assert checkout and len(exitlines)==1
assert before==inventory(S)
report={'schema':'G8-original-100k-failed-shard-receipt-review-v1','observed_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'reviewer':'/root/execution_recon','verdict':'received_and_rejected_as_failed_original_shard','source':record['source_commit'],
 'run_id':37962416564,'attempt':1,'job_id':transport['job'],'slot':{'files':100000,'repetition':0},
 'official_artifact_transport':transport,'original_native_report':native,
 'original_shard_receipt':info(S/'shard.json'),'original_plan':plan,
 'source_bridge':{'input_count':1095,'before_after_raw_bytes_equal':True,'inputs_equal_previously_accepted_50k_R8_bridged_source':True,
                 'fresh_full_product_checkout_or_current_Rust_execution':False,'before':info(S/'source-before.json'),'prior_source':info(CTX/'shard-50000-0/source-before.json')},
 'sealed_files':record['files'],'all11_sealed_file_bytes_hashes_match':True,'shard_inventory_unchanged_after_review':True,
 'drivers':drivers,'first_original_validator_gate':{'path':'scripts/p8_scale_matrix.py','lines':[754,759],'source':predicate,
                  'result_by_direct_receipt_inspection':'false: original status failed and actual native exit3',
                  'original_validate_shard_executed_here':False,'reason':'Root authorized direct failure review. First guard unambiguously rejects before build/binary access; no need to restore/rerun old build/ELF merely to reproduce a known rejection.'},
 'terminal_log':{'metadata':info(ROOT/'job.original-decoded.log'),'exact_checkout':checkout,'outer_actual_exit':exitlines},
 'limits':{'worker_exit_unknown':True,'empty_stderr_does_not_prove_complete_drain':True,'native_BLAKE3_claims_preserved_not_recomputed':True,
           'source_map_bridge_is_to_retained_previous_accepted_source_not_new_full_Git_hydration':True,'phase_analysis':'Separate owner /root/todo_audit; no phase/cause/timing inference or cross-study pooling here.'},
 'execution_boundary':{'original_validator_invocations':0,'build_revalidations':0,'native_hash_file_or_product_runs':0,'ZIP_CRC_reruns':0,
                       'new_downloads':0,'new_measurements':0,'new_accepted_shards':0,'new_accepted_samples':0},
 'existing_G8_credit':{'accepted_shards':4,'accepted_samples':41,'registered_shards':150,'registered_samples':1500},
 'task_credit':{'new_completed':0,'remaining':29},'capacity_sample_credit':0}
p=ROOT/'independent-failed-shard-intake-review.json'
with p.open('x') as f:json.dump(report,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':'failed_original_received_zero_credit','report':info(p)}))
